issues_open_routine_execution_uq.name: issues_open_routine_execution_uq
issues_open_routine_execution_uq.where:
"issues"."origin_kind" = 'routine_execution'
          and "issues"."origin_id" is not null
          and "issues"."hidden_at" is null
          and "issues"."execution_run_id" is not null
          and "issues"."status" in ('backlog', 'todo', 'in_progress', 'in_review', 'blocked')

operator_decision_continuations_generati.name: operator_decision_continuations_generation_check
operator_decision_continuations_generati.value: "operator_decision_continuations"."generation" between 1 and 3 and "operator_decision_continuations"."manual_retry_count" between 0 and 2 and "operator_decision_continuations"."generation" = "operator_decision_continuations"."manual_retry_count" + 1

operator_decision_continuations_lease_ch.name: operator_decision_continuations_lease_check
operator_decision_continuations_lease_ch.value: ("operator_decision_continuations"."state" = 'leased' and "operator_decision_continuations"."lease_owner" is not null and "operator_decision_continuations"."lease_expires_at" is not null) or ("operator_decision_continuations"."state" <> 'leased' and "operator_decision_continuations"."lease_owner" is null and "operator_decision_continuations"."lease_expires_at" is null)

operator_decision_continuations_accepted.name: operator_decision_continuations_accepted_check
operator_decision_continuations_accepted.value: "operator_decision_continuations"."state" <> 'accepted' or ("operator_decision_continuations"."wakeup_request_id" is not null and "operator_decision_continuations"."idempotency_key" is not null and "operator_decision_continuations"."accepted_at" is not null)

operator_decisions_resolved_state_check.name: operator_decisions_resolved_state_check
operator_decisions_resolved_state_check.value: "operator_decisions"."status" <> 'resolved' or ("operator_decisions"."result" is not null and "operator_decisions"."resolved_by_user_id" is not null and "operator_decisions"."resolved_at" is not null)

workflow_definitions_paqo_identity_uq.name: workflow_definitions_paqo_identity_uq
workflow_definitions_paqo_identity_uq.where: "workflow_definitions"."source_kind" = 'paqo' AND "workflow_definitions"."mission_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workflow_definitions"."definition_hash" IS NOT NULL

workflow_resume_executions_lease_check.name: workflow_resume_executions_lease_check
workflow_resume_executions_lease_check.value: ("workflow_resume_executions"."lease_owner" is null and "workflow_resume_executions"."lease_until" is null) or ("workflow_resume_executions"."lease_owner" is not null and "workflow_resume_executions"."lease_until" is not null)

workflow_resume_requests_lease_check.name: workflow_resume_requests_lease_check
workflow_resume_requests_lease_check.value: ("workflow_resume_requests"."lease_owner" is null and "workflow_resume_requests"."lease_until" is null) or ("workflow_resume_requests"."lease_owner" is not null and "workflow_resume_requests"."lease_until" is not null)
